title: What kind of training do your therapists undergo for autism treatment?
metaTitle: Comprehensive Therapist Training for Autism Treatment | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: @Pinnacle Blooms Network, our occupational therapists have a wealth of expertise, including specialized training in autism treatment, assuring qualitative care for kids with autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our occupational therapists are not just qualified with a master's degree in Occupational Therapy but are also enriched with specialized training in autism treatment methodologies. This specialized training equips our therapists with an understanding of the diverse needs of kids with autism, enabling them to tailor the therapy most suitably.
